nom: Clinique Superdefense City Block Broad Spectrum SPF 50 Daily Energy + Face Protector Primer

avis.texte: I so wanted to like this product .but gave me a severe break out .pls upgrade

I really like this subscreen. I have sensitive combination type skin and this has never broken my face out. The consistency is thick, but once applied I do find that it makes a good primer and it works well with my liquid foundation. I apply it and wait for about 2 minutes to let it absorb before continuing on with my makeup routine. I like the tint and have even been happy with the look if it plus Clinique's setting powder for a quick on-the-go more natural look. For me, there's no need to try any of the other options out there.
This face protector is easy to apply (need moisturizer beneath) and really protects your skin from the sun. I do not have to reapply often, depends on the temperature. I use this every day.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I am pleased with the improved appearance and texture of my skin. The product's lightweight formulation has significantly enhanced my complexion.
I've been using this sunscreen for many years. It works great, my skin is sensitive. It's really protects my skin & no issues whatsoever. I love it.
The best part is it doesnt smell like sunscreen at all. I love that. Second, it doesnt break me out. Lays well under foundation. Love wearing it without foundation. Its perfect.

I am soooo glad I gave this sunscreen a second chance. I really enjoy using it. I used it when it first came out and didn't work for me because I compared it to Super City Block SPF 40. This is different. You do have to work a little bit when applying it to blend it. It works really well under my foundation. Makes my skin glow and more even toned. I also like tint. I am 53 and this sunscreen makes my skin glow and gives me a more youthful appearance. It hydrates with out being oily too.

I've used other tinted moisturizers with sunscreen that have more pigmented colors that actually look like foundation and cover imperfections. I would say this doesn't look at all like I'm wearing foundation and doesn't cover any of my sunspots, but it also doesn't have a white cast on my medium tan skin. I've been using it daily for a couple of weeks and it also doesn't make little crumbly bits all over my face like some primers do. For my 47 year old skin this works perfectly so I will continue to use it and I'm going to try to get my teen daughter to wear it too; she hates makeup so hopefully the fact that this doesn't add color should check the right boxes for her. I'm also going to add that we both have eczema and Clinique is the one brand that doesn't cause flares that we can both use.

I got this product and use this for couple of years, no more dark spots or hyper-pigments appear on my face, even I am a dog person and need to go walk my dog under the sun often. A bit thick cream, but it never causes me a pimple or break out.

avis.titre: I would absolutely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I love Clinique products and am especially pleased with this cream so that I can ride the motorcycle without getting too much sunburn on my face and forehead.

I have very sun sensitive skin & love this product. On busy days I use this on top of a face setum & moisturizer, then add face powder & Im out the door. Also takes liquid foundation well. Im actually here looking to buy my 2nd tube. I have rosacea that causes acne & this product was not irritating to my face. Big win!

The tube is larger than it looks online. I wasn't expecting this full size sunscreen in the gift set it came in. I love knowing that I'm protecting my skin while getting a bit of natural coverage and a boost of energy and confidence to boot. Great on its own or with make-up. It feels light going on and stays weightless throughout the day.
Product is lightweight, goes on the face easily, a little goes a long way. I highly recommend!!

avis.titre: I don't go anywhere without it!
avis.texte: Now that summer is here, I don't go anywhere without it! I used to sparingly in the winter but now that we are in full sun days its a must! Its not to thick or greasy. Its blends into my skin beautifully and my makeup last all day! It does a great job of hiding and protecting my dark spots to make sure they dont get worse or more gets added to my face. Keep this product around forever please! The 50 is my jam! Sensitive skin commemter here! :)

avis.titre: Not sure why the negative reviews! It's my HG!
avis.texte: Tried it in store per the clinique associate and I really like it! It is on the thicker side but it spreads nicely and doesnt pill when paired with clinique moisture surge 100H or peach and lily's matcha moisturizer (my two HG moisturizers). You need your moisturizer to dry for 15 minutes and THEN apply your spf, this dramatically reduces it from pilling. It does look very orange when dispensed but it gives me a great sheer tint that looks like I put makeup on, its beautiful! So I wear alone typically on non-makeup days but does work very well as a primer as well (I use IT cosmetics CC+ foundation in light warm medium. For reference, I am also WN04 Bone in Clinique even better makeup so light/med and the tint works great for me. Wish it came in a bigger bottle! As it is pricy when you apply the standard 1/4tsp.

avis.titre: The best i came to leave a review
avis.texte: Im sooooo impressed with this product! I only need a little and i blend a small amount of foundtaion for a sunkissed look. I will not be running out of this all year round! Woohoo

avis.titre: Perfect under makeup – no white cast!
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by how well this sunscreen works with makeup. It blends effortlessly into the skin, leaving no white cast at all—which is such a rare find! This one's definitely staying in my daily routine!
Can't get over the tacky texture - not expected at this price point. I'll be going back to the Shiseido sunscreen - still haven't found anything better. Really disappointed.
I'm pretty fair and wore this every day in Aruba for a week without having to reapply throughout the day. Great sun protection and light weight. My new go to product in the summer

avis.titre: The orange ring is not fun and doesn't spread well
avis.texte: Also the closer you get to the bottom of the tube it begins to pill

avis.titre: Great sun protection & goes on easy
avis.texte: I love this face sunscreen. I bought a 2nd one to keep in my backpack. I'm a man with dry, sensitive, and very pale skin. This goes on easy and just needs a thin layer. It doesn't run into my eyes when I sweat. It goes on so smooth and quickly dries/absorbs into the skin. It has a slight tint - so that you don't look like a ghost with thick sunscreen. It looks natural, the tint does not show - it only prevents it from looking like white paint. It stays on when I sweat - and I sweat a lot. I am very happy with this sunscreen. It is part of an overall routine - but my skin has never looked better.
It works perfectly in Florida!!!! It is neither greasy nor sticky at all. I use this product for more than 2 years, once I started, my skin gets healthier.

I use this in addition to my moisture surge. I love the hydration of moisture surge and love the finish of this sunblock. Everybody I have let try (varying skin types and shades) has looked amazing after using this. Your skin will look more evenly textured and smooth after using this. Its like wearing makeup, but you're not and it looks super natural. It also works fantastic under make up. Great primer. I have rosacea and acne prone skin that is sensitive and out of all of the products I have ever tried, this and moisture surge hydrate and protect the best. I have dry combination skin.
I have been using this product daily for over a year. I really like it and I feel it smooths the skin and helps prevent sun damage.

avis.titre: Bring Back City Block SPF 40 This is so disappointing!
avis.texte: I was Super City Block spf 40 user for years. Last Feb I was needing to replenish and found out that it had been discontinued! NOT happy with the replacement Super Defense at all. I do not like the texture- it is too sticky making putting makeup on over it a mess and the color is off. Please listen to your customers and just bring back the former product. I will not be repurchasing this product but would definitely buy the older one. If it's not broke, why fix it?
SPF protector works all day and quick absorbing and oil-free, skin looks pretty

avis.titre: Solid sunscreen with a good tint
avis.texte: I'd never used the CB40 that others cite so I can't compare, but this sunscreen is pretty solid! Works perfectly for me and is gentle and easy to wash off at the end of the day. Have used it for a few years now, nearly since it first came out. Leaving a 5 star review so Clinique knows there are some out there who do love it!

I love this sunscreen so much! It's not greasy at all and feels very light when it goes on. And the best part is it matches every skin type; I am VERY pale and even though it comes out of the bottle tan, it blends perfectly (without any other makeup, this is all I wear for daily coverage). My friends of all skin tones have borrowed it and everyone can wear this!

Clinique keeps its customers because you produce outstanding skin care products. So which marketing genius decided to discontinue one of your best products with a loyal customer base and replace it with an inferior substitute? This is not even close to the quality of CB 40…Joining the other 1-star reviews begging you to add CB 40 back to your sunscreen line.

I absolutely love this stuff and cannot understand the negative reviews. Great tint, high SPF, and easy to apply. Best of all, it does not burn my eyes!! I apply it alone to my neck after serums and moisturizer but do mix with my foundation when I apply to my face.

When this product was first launched, I tried it and did not like it due to its texture. I have been using City Block since its inception in the various SPFs, and the SPF 40 was my favorite. I just tried the SPF50 again, as I need a higher SPF in the summer. I warmed the product up in my hands and then applied it to my face and it made all the difference. Yes, it is a little more difficult to spread but the effort is worth it in this case. Try it again!

I was given the sunscreen by my mom try, but after a few weeks of using it I notices it made my skin extremely dry. It also caused my make up to separate even when allowing 15 minutes to dry before applying foundation. I've increased my moisturizer usage hoping that would help offset the dryness, but it has not helped at all. This sunscreen has an odd smell to it.

I've had such a hard time finding a face sunscreen that didnt mess with my skin or makeup and this is it! I'm obsessed with how easy it is to apply after my skincare and it was no issue at all with my makeup after application! It doesn't have a typical sunscreen smell. I will say, for someone like myself who had oily combo skin, this might be a hit or miss for you, but for myself personally I didn't mind it at all :)

I've noticed that a lot of ppl hate this sunscreen, but I've loved it from the moment I've used it (it's been years now). I use it after my moisturizer and before my makeup and it's been perfect! It makes my brown skin so smooth and glowy! My sunscreen staple!
My sister-in-law got this and I've always wanted to try it and have it my own and I love it 😊
Smells terrible and goes on like flaky paste. Overall gross feeling. Very dissatisfied.
Goes on smoothly over my moisturizer and is not heavy. Very light tint which I like and SPF Broad Spectrum 50 is perfect for walking my dog and gardening.
So glad I tried this sunscreen for my face. It applies smoothly and makes my face flow while protecting my skin. I love it!

I used to love the spf 40 version of this so of course i tried this one when i had the chance! Bought one for me and one for my mom, sadly it doesnt blend into my medium shade skin, leaving a pinkish mask and starts peeling all over the hairline, perhaps works better on pale skin, sad because i wanted to love this just as much as i do the spf 40 version!

I use this everyday. It applies super creamy over moisturized skin, brightens up my complexion and doesn't irritate my eyes. It looks great on its own and makes a perfect primer under foundation. I'm fair/light and even though there appears to be a tint out of the tube, the only effect on my face is a brightening/blurring effect.

I've tried countless sunblocks, most of which caused me breakouts and I usually hate the way they feel on my skin or smell. This one is my GOAT. It layers well over my other skincare and makes a great primer for makeup. I always repurchase this.

avis.titre: Bring back the discontinued cityblock SPF 40
avis.texte: I have used the older version of cityblock SPF 40 for almost 20 years, and this new version just can't compare. It's thicker, and caulkier. My biggest concern is that the color is off. It makes the complexion look dull and ashy. There was something magical in the older version that made your skin look glowy/healthier with just the right amount of coverage that flatters the overall appearance. Why did you have to change it for the worse? I know it can be tricky to get the ingredients and concentration right with the higher SPF. But, the R&D team please listen to your customers. Like so many others have pledged, please bring back the older version of cityblock SPF 40. You are losing your long-time customers....

I've lived an active outdoorsy lifestyle for many years and I have tried many sunblocks. I bought this on a whim and I'm so glad that I did! I use it everyday either on its own or under my makeup. I have light, sensitive, dry, acne prone skin. This product blends well over my other skincare and doesn't feel heavy. Its also beautiful under makeup. I'll keep repurchasing.

Took me a bit to get used to this product esp after using city block spf 40, but is now a staple in my everyday morning routine. It blends really nice into the skin after warming the product up with my fingertips. Thats the key is warming the prodcut up in your hands. I love how it has just a little tint to bring down redness; with a little concealer and transparency powder on top, it creates a beautiful finish!
I've always worn many variations of City Block for years. It keeps the sun at bay even on the beaches of our world. I walk outside in all seasons and have no age spots, even at 76.

Love it. Great for daily wear alone or under makeup. It's the tube I take to the beach. Completely sheer. It's what you need for real sun protection that is not in a makeup and can be worn on non makeup days or those days you're going to be in the sun like the beach. It is a little think. But so is my zinc sunscreen that gives my face a white tint I use for non makeup outings. Tip- apply immediately after moisturizing and always moisturize before applying. Or mix it with you moisturizer. True sun protection is always going to be thick. Sunscreen in makeup is premixed with makeup moisturizer (why mix it or apply immediately after). Who wants to wear makeup to the beach? Sure zinc sunscreen- super thick - is works, but I don't like the white look. I bought this for my 12 year old daughter. She does not want to wear makeup. But she needs to start sunscreen protection and develop that necessary habit. She was skeptical because of the tint. I explained to her it was because of the titanium dioxide. She tried it and loved it. Some may hate it, but it's the best I've found. Just use moisturizer with it. That's the key!
It's little bit dry once you first apply, overall a good product that can use everyday.
Too heavy. Hard to spread without applying a lot of pressure.
It is definitely a thick-feeling protector, but just when you apply it, your skin feels super smooth and flawless afterwards, without a greasy feeling.

avis.titre: BEST Face Sunscreen on the market
avis.texte: I live in Phoenix and am over 50. I have tried ALL the sunscreens. This one is the best by far!!! It has a minimal tint that blends in well to any skin tone, its thick enough that it doesnt gravitate into the eyes, but thin enough that you don't feel caked and greasy. I dont feel like I have anything on my face but it slightly evens out my complexion. Its my go-to daily face sunscreen with or without makeup.

This cream is the worst out of all options at Clinique. I have been Clinique fun for over two decades, using for more than 15 years city block spf 40, every single day both in the city as well as on the beach ..it was wonderful, giving a radiance to your skin without it looking oily , it was a substitute of a make up due to its lightly bronzing- skin equalising effect ... Bringing great protection It's orange substitute is an opposite to it. My skin is normal to dry these days but this new city block spf 50 leaves it oily, sticky , very heavy, the cream is dense and even difficult to wash out with a soap so sticky it is... I do not recommend and deeply regret the old version that was a huge success is out of market :(

I don't understand the negative reviews on this !!! I am a police woman, I am outside in the Florida sun , and I'm 50 . I have tried all the sunscreen lol. This is thick enough to stay put but goes on well and blends in . Gives a slight coverage, but not really much . No white cast , sometimes I wear it alone (summer at work) mist times I put smash box halo or it cc over it . No problem reapplying, no eye irritation, I love this sunscreen love love love please don't discontinue

I had to purchase this product in place of my FAVORITE Super City Block 25. By comparison, the tint is a bit off, not as smooth to apply, and feels sticky on the face the entire time it is on. I hope the Super City Block 25 returns to the product lineup.

avis.titre: Great protection and doesn't make me sweat
avis.texte: Manynface sunblocks seem to make me sweat but this does not and looks good. I don't get the other reviews.
Not happy with this sunscreen. It's hard to apply. I feel like I'm pulling on my face to get it applied and burns if you get it near eyes. It leaves horrible orange stains on swim shirts.
It would have been so much better if they just made it clear but it has this ugly orange tint.

I love this Clinique sunscreen as it has a really the highest spf with a slight tint. It can leave you a little shiny but I add little bit of powder on every sunscreen I wear to reduce the shine to zero. if you do that the shiny shouldn't be a problem plus it feels light weight on your skin.

I love this Clinique sunscreen as it has a really the highest spf with a slight tint. It can leave you a little shiny but I add little bit of powder on every sunscreen I wear to reduce the shine to zero. if you do that the shiny shouldn't be a problem plus it feels light weight on your skin.
I have 40+ dry combo skin for reference. I love this aunscreen. It is great under makeup beaxuse its so lightweight and hydrating. It also doesnt break me out. This is my holy grail product all year

avis.titre: I would buy this over and over again
avis.texte: I would buy this over and over again I love that it is tinted so i don't have to wear foundation with it

I used to be a huge fan of City Block SPF 40 since it was literally the only SPF cream that did not break me out. So I was very concerned when I saw that my favorite product had been discontinued and read some reviews saying that this new version with higher SPF was not as nice. But I've tried it and I actually can not say this one feels that different on the skin. It is also very light, I don't feel it on my skin and the most important thing it does not cause any breakouts or clogged pores.

I love this sunscreen so much now that I've learned what my skin actually needs. Some people feel this product is too heavy as I used to think. However, I've changed my moisturizing routine and now my once dry and oily combination skin is balanced. I use super defense city block as a primer. My skin feels soft and glowing all day, not oily, with the extra SPF that I need. The tint helps to even out my skin tone in a very natural looking way which I prefer. I will be using this product for many, many years to come. Thank you Clinique!

The "haters"out there are nuts!! I also used the other version..spf 45 is it? And I thought it was wonderful too. But this spf 50 version is fantastic. I live in a tropical country and use tube after tube. A WONDERFUL SUNCREEN

avis.titre: Bring the original CliniqueSuper City Block SPF40 back
avis.texte: This just doesn't do it for me. I really really need the original one. I used it for years and can't believe it is discontinued

Definitely not worth the price, $50 for a decent spf is crazy. It does what it needs to do but that's about it. Save your money, go for cheaper options. I'll probably switch to a brand with more clean ingredients and that doesn't test on animals.

avis.titre: Wish it were truly a mineral sunscreen
avis.texte: It is thick and initially felt weird applying but I slowly got used to it. It works and absorbs well into the skin leaving no whitecast. It doesn't provide any coverage although it is slightly tinted. It gives a nice warm glow. The only thing I wish for this would be a truly mineral sunscreen.
I love that the SPF is higher and it doesn't leave my skin greasy at all. It doesn't mark my wrinkles.

PLEASE bring back the City Block 45! I loved that one as it worked great as a face primer too. This new 50 SPF makes my face feel sticky & doesn't go on as smoothly as the 45 did. Makes my make up look blotchy after a while. You had a great thing with the old City Block 45, don't know why you had to change it. Will not buy this again nor recommend it to anyone.

Several minutes after I've given my daily Clinique moisturizer time to settle into my skin I will apply a layer of sunscreen. After giving both of those products time to settle I will apply my favorite Clinique foundation. My skin never feels uncomfortable with these layers I've applied. It all soaks in nicely and I'm protected from harmful rays of the sun.
I loathe this product. Please bring back City Block SPF 45. This is no substitute for that and the City Block SPF 25 is not strong enough to fully protect my face during the summer months.

avis.titre: Great for pale warm toned skin!! Good for sensitive skin.
avis.texte: This is my FAVORITE TINTED SUNSCREEN but, I have very very pale warm yellow skin (W01 Flax is my foundation color). I recommend dabbing it all over the face and then blending it in with a damp makeup sponge to get an even application. It does have a glowy (and shiny) look. The shine can be fixed with a transparent setting powder so it doesn't bother me. It may not look great on all skin tones but most tinted sunscreen are too dark for me. This is the one tinted sunscreen I've found that 1) doesn't burn my eyes, and 2) is not dark yellow on my pale skin. This works great under makeup and can also be applied over markup with a dabbing motion with a makeup sponge. 100% would recommend.
This is so smooth, light and perfectly moisturizing sunscreen. Using it under the foundation feels perfect!

avis.titre: PLEASE Bring Back the REAL City Block
avis.texte: This is, in a word, dreadful. Please please please bring back City Block (I can't recall if it was SPF 40 or 45) with the tint in it.

I'm very disappointed with this product, this new formula leaves the skin sticky and with a yellow tone, please bring back the Super City Block 45 it is a product that I have used for more than 10 years
Absolutely love this! Beautiful natural coverage with protection from the sun, perfect combination!
I use this as a last step to my makeup and just apply some concealer. It keeps my skin protected and hydrated. No breakout issues.

This is pretty good as a light, sheer coverage instead of foundation. If applied as a sunscreen it would be too thick for my preference, as one who never wears foundation. I like to lather on sunscreen so this would be too much for that purpose. I am light to medium skin with slight yellow undertone and tan easily, and a dab blends into my skin.

I had been using a facial sunscreen that I bought from my dermatologist but that was very inconvenient. My dermatologist said I need something to protect from the sun AND the environment. This said it does both........we shall see. So far I really like it. I goes on easy and doesn't have a greasy feel at all.
This is a great face sunscreen. It is light weight and not oily. I would highly recommend as a daily use!

I have Rosacea so I'm always looking for products that won't irritate my skin, especially sunblocks. I'm also an avid hiker and spend alot of time outdoors. I took this sunblock for a long backpacking trip. I used it alone most of the time and my face felt moisturized. I reapplied it every few hours as I sweat alot. I didn't mind that it was thick because I felt it provided more protection. I also liked how it is a little tinted, as it helps even out the skin. Most importantly, I didn't have any breakouts on my skin. I was very happy how it performed. I can say this product is good for the city and mountains.

I tried this product despite the negative reviews I read. I'm glad I did. It is thick and could be hard to spread, I think, if you haven't prepped your skin with a moisturizer first. But if you've prepped your skin, it covers well and dries quickly and, for me anyway, works great as a primer. Plus, it's 50 SPF which is great for protecting the skin. I wish it didn't have octinoxate, so I give it 4 stars, but this otherwise works really well for my super sensitive skin.
I absolutely love this product! It feels Wonderful! Buy it you will be happy you did! Works as a primer as well! :D < 3

Although it does provide sun protection, I was really hoping that this product would be comparable to the Clinique Super City Block Oil - Free Daily Face Protector SPF 40, but it is not. It is too thick and heavy and not as easy to apply. I loved the sheer application of the old product.. the protection was fantastic, the coverage and tint were great and it actually improved my overall complexion. This new product does not even come close. PLEASE bring back the old product (please do not recommend City Block SPF 25.. it's not the same).

I wanted to try this product since I get sunburn easily and it has been working for me. However, the only problem I have with this product; is tiny pimples pop up whenever I used it, but go away quickly.

This is a great face sunscreen because it doesn't run or get in your eyes! It's nice and thick so you know it's not going anywhere. The main issue is how badly it stains because of the color. Be careful what you wear this with because it does not come out.

I received this product as a sample but I love it and will be purchasing in the future. I am very fair skinned, so I appreciated the 50 SPF. The cream feels so good going on and leaves my skin slightly dewy but not greasy. I also think the tint works well with my skin tone. It has been a great alternative to heavy foundation this summer. I will note that I use face moisturizer before applying this product because I generally have dry/combination skin and need the extra moisture boost.

I was kind of hoping I didn't love this so I wouldn't want to keep repurchasing, but I really do. If you use the amount of sunscreen you're supposed to use, this takes some time to really work it into the skin. But leaves a beautiful finish and makeup sits on top well. I've had some trouble layering other sunscreen later on throughout the day, though. So if you're reapplying regularly, this might not be the best choice.

Love it. Moving to Atlanta caused a number of allergic reactions and I was struggling with sunscreen which is a must down here. I have no issues with this product which is a great relief. I don't love the texture when putting it on, but then it just soaks in and doesn't feel greasy or weird. I like to use a gel moisturizer like moisture surge first.

I'm not sure what people don't like about it. I found it to be a great sunscreen on its own but it also works as a light, active summer foundation if you don't want to do the whole makeup routine. The tint works well for my fair-light medium skin tone.

I got this as a sample and started using it everyday and OMG how my skin has improved!!! It goes on smooth, doesn't leave a white residue, it does feel a little thick but once you rub it out it feels good and lightweight!! It goes on so well under makeup, I'd definitely recommend getting it!!!

I resisted buying this because I'd been loyal to the same thing we were all loyal to. Finally, I decided to try it because I wasn't very happy with alternatives I'd found — I wish I'd caved sooner! It leaves a slightly matte, diffused finish and keeps my skin protected. I do moisturize underneath, but this isn't marketed as an all-in-one, so that's not unexpected. No frills and no scent, but also no irritation at all. If you're undecided, try it and make up your own mind instead of being overly swayed by laments about discontinuation. (Like I was!)

avis.titre: Heavy cream, but left my skin dry
avis.texte: Received this item as a sample. While only a little cream comes out at a time, it is a heavy cream. It felt great going on; however, within a half an hour my face was super dry around my nose and chin. I will not use again.
This product was out of stock for months. I'm glad it is available now. I didn't have any issues with it.
I love Clinique products & this one is terrific! Evens out my skin & makeup goes on smooth.

I think a lot of people use it to cover their blemishes because of the slight tint. I don't think it even makes a light coverage foundation substitution. However, it gives a nice glow. It has no scent as all Clinique products don't. The application is smooth and it lasts 8 hours. There's no eye irritation when sweating, so that's a plus!

I use to use the city block SPF45 but it clogged my pores and end up stop using it and gave it to my mom to use. she loved it. Went to the store to get it for my mom instead and decided to try it again but didn't realize they discontinued the spf45. got home and saw that it was this one. I tried it and it's been amazing! I used it first before my serums and moisturizer (I use the clinique dramatically different lotion & Estee lauder perfectionist pro rapid firm and lift treatment & idealist, & good molecules Yerba mate wake up eye gel). it gives off this nice fresh glow/flushed/healthy look & feel. I don't need to reapply it. it does feel thick at first but goes away and don't feel anything. I have normal sometimes oily T zone skin. I apply it on my face and down my neck and upper chest area that will be seen. it doesn't get oily or make my face oily at all through out the day. definitely will continue to purchase.
I put this on before makeup. Love the feel. Didn't turn white on my face.
I have very sensitive skin. I can't do mineral sunscreen. this is the only sunscreen I can wear daily and not breakout!
I'm returning this product. It makes my face feel like I'm wearing a ton of foundation and I do not wear makeup. It also leaves a light white cast on my face. I'm a tan closer brownish complexion.

avis.titre: Best mineral sunscreen I have tried!
avis.texte: I love this sunscreen! I prefer a mineral sunscreen, but hate the white cast most leave. This one fully absorbs so that you can go on to wear makeup or have a beautiful bare face look!

I actually like the texture of this product. It is a bit thicker than some lotions, but I like the protective feel it leaves on my skin after I spread it out. It has a tint that immediately disappears on my fair/fair-medium skin tone. I have sensitive skin and I had no irritation with this product at all. I am here to reorder a second tube, so I definitely like it enough to buy it again.

avis.titre: It works, but only for Exercise
avis.texte: I am have light olive skin, ( light medium for make-up), and would only use this when outside walking. It has that white cast so many sunscreens contain. This would def not work for everyday use due to that "zinc face" look. I did not have any issues with using this sunscreen near my eyes. I may try the City Block SPF 25. But I do wish it were in a stronger SPF, like 40.
My skin is combination and I've used it several times with each making my skin oily. Waisted $$
